text:
lina: FYI seeing a spike in GPU attach latency in eu-west3 starting ~11:05 UTC, a bunch of pods pending 'waiting for local-device'.
omar: correlates with local-nvme read IO surge and high read latencies. metrics show metadata-compactor and checksum-revalidate jobs kicked at 11:04.
storage-bot: ALERT: local-read-latency > 250ms on nvme devices across 48 hosts (eu-west3) window 11:04-11:12 UTC. gpu-attach-failures +12%.
ops-oncall: any recent scheduling changes? we had compactor rollout scheduled for 11:00 as canary.
kai: yeah I rolled compactor v3 canary to 50 hosts at 10:58, and revalidation job config bumped concurrency to 8 earlier today. assumed harmless for cold nodes.
lina: looks like selector matched /hot-gpu/ tag too — so hot stripe hosts got both compactor + revalidate overlap. oom.
meera: running quick grep on scheduler logs: `selector=tags in (hot-gpu,storage-hot)` — that wrong set included gpu hosts. kai, can you roll the canary back?
kai: rolling back canary now: `scheduler rollback compactor-v3 --canary=50`
storage-bot: ACTION: compactor-v3 canary rollback initiated (target 50 -> 0) at 11:09:12 UTC.
omar: immediate mitigation: 1) lower revalidator concurrency to 2 on hosts with gpu tag 2) throttle metadata compactor to 10% io 3) failover provisioning away from eu-west3 if remaining capacity elsewhere.
ops-oncall: applying the throttle: `compactorctl set-io-share --selector="tag:hot-gpu" --share=10` -> applied.
storage-bot: UPDATE: revalidator concurrency reduced to 2 on 48 hot-gpu hosts. compactor io-share=10% applied.
lina: after throttling attach success rate went from 82% -> 98% across 20m. local read latency dropped to ~60ms. sample iostat from gnode-eu-21: 

Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await  r_await w_await svctm %util
nvme0n1         210.4   45.2  4096.0  1024.0   8.1   5.2    1.5    0.35  31.4

meera: filing STOR-7012: "compactor selector included hot-gpu -> concurrent revalidate -> read amplification -> gpu attach throttling". assigning to kai + infra-storage.
kai: adding canary gate: require negative-probe that verifies gpu-tag match count == 0 before expanding compactor. will push a patch today.
omic-bot: NOTE: provisioning bias applied: queue-provisioner rerouted new requests away from eu-west3 -> us-east1/eu-north until metric recovery.
omar: ops note: delaying compaction/revalidate increases metadata backlog (disk index bloat) and may bump short-term S3 retrievals during GC windows. we prefer availability but track cost impact.
ops-oncall: documented emergency playbook steps in runbook under "storage/io-throttle". added alert rule: local-read-latency > 150ms AND gpu-attach-failures > 5% -> pager to eng-oncall.
lina: follow-ups: - add scheduler pre-check to block compactor/revalidate on nodes with pending gpu-allocs - add queued-io soft cap per-device (default 20%) - run simulated overlap test in staging to find safe concurrency numbers
kai: ack. I'll include a feature flag to gate global expansion.
meera: closing incident once postmortem is drafted. I'll draft root-cause and mitigation list in STOR-7012. thanks for the quick response.
lina: nice work everyone. :white_check_mark:
